specifications.boundary_transition: Twelve K-blocks over four stages produce three uses per barrier slot per persistent tile, crossing from even to odd generation parity.
specifications.rationale: Both partitions recompute phase as k_block_idx // num_stages inside each persistent tile. After three uses, the next tile reuses phase zero against a slot whose generation parity has toggled, allowing stale synchronization and asynchronous shared-memory reuse.

semantic_ground_truth.rationale: The pinned source trace proves stale phase parity across persistent tiles; prior H100 execution independently produced a launch failure for this legal shape.

specifications.boundary_transition: Reduce from fourteen to eight uses per barrier slot per tile while preserving an even generation count.
specifications.rationale: K=4096 is divisible by BLOCK_K=128 and gives 32 K-blocks; with four stages each slot is used eight times, so the erroneous per-tile phase reset happens to preserve parity and serves as an even-cycle control.

semantic_ground_truth.rationale: The even number of per-slot uses preserves parity across persistent tiles; the earlier hardware control completed correctly.

specifications.boundary_transition: Four K-blocks over four stages produce the smallest one-use-per-slot odd parity cycle.
specifications.rationale: This is the smallest legal BLOCK_K-aligned K that exercises every stage once; a second persistent tile immediately exposes phase reset against generation one.

semantic_ground_truth.rationale: One use per slot toggles parity before the next persistent tile, while the source restarts phaseIdx at zero.

specifications.rationale: Official pro-shape specialization: b=128,h=16,r=7168,d=1024 maps to B=16,M=128,N=1024,K=7168. Four stages give fourteen uses per barrier slot per persistent tile, an even parity cycle covered by the upstream numerical oracle.

semantic_ground_truth.rationale: This specialization belongs to the official parameter matrix and is compared with the PyTorch reference.
